threads.body: A patch release leaves `main` on the published `-dev` schema URL. Prepare release always starts from `main` and merges its release URL back there, so releasing, for example, `0.1.1` then skipping this job never restores an `-unreleased` URL. The next Prepare release run without an override also defaults to `0.1.1` and fails because that tag already exists. Create the next-minor bump PR for patch releases too, or reject patch versions during preparation if they are unsupported.

threads.body: The documented manual retry cannot recover a run that published the release successfully but then failed in `bump-schema-url`. A new dispatch reaches `gh release create` again, which fails because `v$VERSION` already exists, so the bump job never runs. Document using GitHub Actions' **Re-run failed jobs** after publication, or make the workflow verify and reuse an existing matching release.

threads.body: If the branch push succeeds but `gh pr create` fails, the documented "Re-run failed jobs" recovery fails too. The retry checks out `main` and creates a new commit on the same branch name, so pushing it is rejected as a non-fast-forward update to the branch left by the first attempt. Reuse an existing remote bump branch and check for an existing PR before creating one, so a failed PR-creation request can be retried without manually deleting the branch.

+          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
+        run: |
+          awk -v heading="## v${VERSION}" '$0 == heading { found = 1; next } /^## / { found = 0 } found' CHANGELOG.md > /tmp/release-notes.md

+
+      - name: Load shared version pins

+            .build/package/manifest-dev.yaml \
+            .build/package/registry-dev.yaml \
+            --target "$TARGET" \
+            --title "v${VERSION}" \
+            --notes-file /tmp/release-notes.md
+
+  # Runs here rather than on `release: published` because releases created
+  # with github.token don't trigger other workflows.
+  bump-schema-url:
+    needs: release
+    permissions:
+      contents: write # required for pushing the bump branch
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

+        env:
+          VERSION: ${{ needs.release.outputs.version }}
+        run: |
+          IFS=. read -r major minor _ <<< "$VERSION"
+          next_version="$major.$((minor + 1)).0"
+          echo "NEXT_VERSION=$next_version" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          make set-schema-url-unreleased VERSION="$next_version"
+
+      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
+        id: otelbot-token
+        with:
+          client-id: ${{ vars.OTELBOT_SEMANTIC_CONVENTIONS_GENAI_CLIENT_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.OTELBOT_SEMANTIC_CONVENTIONS_GENAI_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          permission-pull-requests: write
+
+      - name: Create pull request
+        env:
+          # Use the App token for PR creation so the pull request runs workflows.
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.otelbot-token.outputs.token }}
+          VERSION: ${{ needs.release.outputs.version }}
+        run: |
+          if git diff --quiet; then
+            echo "schema_url already up to date"
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          message="[chore] Bump schema_url to ${NEXT_VERSION}-unreleased"
+          branch="otelbot/bump-schema-url-${NEXT_VERSION}"
+
+          git checkout -b "$branch"
+          git commit -a -m "$message"
+          git push --set-upstream origin "$branch"
+          gh pr create --title "$message" \
+                       --body "Post-release update for \`v${VERSION}\`." \
+                       --head "$branch" \
+                       --base main

threads.body: The bump job checks out the latest `main` but computes its replacement URL from the older release job's output. If a failed bump job for `0.1.0` is retried after `main` has advanced to `0.2.0-dev` or `0.3.0-unreleased`, it opens a PR replacing that newer state with `0.2.0-unreleased`. Before applying the setter, verify that the current manifest still has the schema URL of the release being completed, and skip or fail if it has advanced.
